content: maya: quick design review — noticed a few accessibility + copy probs in Security > Data controls: retention timeline, region dropdown default, and KMS labels. Posting screenshots in thread. sam: thanks. can you list the specific nits? maya: 1) retention slider label currently says "Data retention" vs "Retention period" — legal testers preferred "Retention period" for clarity. 2) timeline line reads "deleted after X" — suggest "auto-delete after X days" so it's explicit. 3) region selector defaults to "US" without hint it's inferred from billing — confused some test users. liam: from impl POV we default by account.billing_region; we can add a hint text. changing default behavior is riskier (affects provisioning). also note region change triggers a revalidate of KMS keys and may be rate-limited. anya: accessibility notes: the KMS "Managed key" pill has contrast below AA on light mode. also the pill lacks an aria-description for ownership — screen readers only announce "Managed key" which is ambiguous. propose adding an aria-label: `aria-label="Key ownership: Customer-managed — stored in your KMS"`. kevin: microcopy suggestion for audit events: replace terse "key rotated" with "encryption key rotated by [user]" and make timestamps explicit with timezone (e.g., "2026-03-23 15:04 UTC"). users asked for timezone context. maya: can we standardize timestamps to ISO + timezone? users requested timezone awareness in logs. liam: backend stores ISO already. front-end currently localizes. short-term: render UTC suffix server-side for audit rows (we can add localized client option later). i'll send a PR for the suffix. sam: design adjustments: switch the KMS pill to an outline variant to improve contrast; add a small info icon that's keyboard-focusable and targets a tooltip. tooltip text should be concise and include ownership + minimal next steps if customer-managed. add aria-describedby to the info icon. maya: small copy tweak for retention help copy: current "Retention applies to generated content" -> propose "Retention period controls how long generated content and logs are stored." simpler and clearer. deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/PR/1234 — includes copy + aria label updates :white_check_mark: CI passed. liam: noted. i'll add the aria-label attributes like so: ```html Customer key ``` and include " UTC" suffix in the audit log timestamp rendering. will have a small migration in edge cases but low risk. anya: i'll run an a11y smoke (axe + voiceover) against the updated pattern lib once PR is up, and do a quick screen-reader pass on the console pages (security & audit). i can do this tomorrow morning. maya: great — assigning this to design+eng+docs. kevin, can you update the release notes section for console changes? cc @kevin kevin: on it. draft release notes blurb: 1) clarified retention language and help text; 2) improved KMS pill contrast and added screen-reader label; 3) audit log timestamps now include UTC suffix for clarity. will link PRs. sam: attaching updated mock (exported tokens) in thread: https://figma.redwood/file/abcd — outline pill + info icon + tooltip copy included. maya: thanks everyone. let's aim to ship this in the next console patch. if anything blocks a11y tests, flag immediately. liam: will monitor for regressions. anya: i'll post test notes after the pass. kevin: release notes draft pushed to docs repo, will iterate after design review. maya: closing loop — follow-ups: liam PR for aria + UTC suffix, sam final mock, anya a11y results, kevin notes. :thumbsup:
